name: Makgeolli
description: Cloudy unfiltered rice brew, lightly fizzy and only mildly alcoholic.

histamine.note: Unfiltered and still fermenting in the bottle — live yeast plus alcohol.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Mild and cloudy as it tastes, a single bowl still delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
